timestamp_note: EIA reporting rule extended from combined cycles to all evidenced unit-code groups after inspecting raw HY rows; no model parameters changed. v1.0 and CC-only v1.1 results retained. Retrospective development, not blind validation
status: retrospective development protocol fixed before these new model scores; not blind validation
data: June month-end EIA-860M snapshots 2019-2026, assumed available by December origin; exact historical released bytes not certified
active_outcome: OP in Operating, without a conflicting sheet; SB/OA/OS are not OP; missing/conflicting status is unknown, not zero
target: June month-end OP inventory, not all-summer availability or accredited resources
physical_capacity: reported net summer MW retained on EIA reporting carrier; a same-plant, nonblank Unit Code group with a single positive carrier exceeding its own nameplate by >1 MW and consistent sheet/status/BA/technology identifies an aggregate reporting pattern, not missing additional member capacity; covered blank members carry zero additional accounting credit and no fit weight. Other missing combined-cycle capacities remain unknown and are not imputed. Non-CC missing forecast features use origin technology NS/NC among independent complete rows, without a hard <=1 cap. Target observations never imputed; scored stock is the sum of reported-known capacity, not a complete engineering inventory
shared_capacity_source: EIA-860 instructions, Schedule 3A line 3, PDF page 11; Schedule 3B line 2a, PDF page 12; https://www.eia.gov/survey/form/eia_860/instructions.pdf
reporting_carrier_boundary: holding the reporting carrier is an inventory-accounting convention, not verified joint-block engineering availability; mixed-status or ambiguous groups flagged; historical carrier changes remain observable rating changes
schedule: retain current OP until known retirement date; add visible planned units whose published operation date is no later than target June; ambiguous same-year missing-month schedules do not enter
learned: capacity-weighted target OP frequency using only past origins with target <= current origin; exact horizon, origin state or project stage, technology, and whether schedule is due
fallback: drop technology only, retaining horizon and state/stage/schedule-due flag; otherwise use announced_schedule probability; no fitted balance intercept or region-specific tuning
unseen_supply: separate expectation condition: mean resolved past target capacity of genuinely absent-at-origin, newly operating units, for the same region/technology/horizon; require at least two matured origin-target pairs; otherwise unsupported and no contribution credited
capacity_modifications: origin-reported uprate and derate dates and amounts enter the announced-schedule condition only; ambiguous dates do not enter; learned model holds origin unit size so realized size error stays auditable
regional_assignment: origin BA held fixed in forecasts; realized BA moves and apparent prior-existing inventory corrections separated from new construction in the audit
seasonal_index: 2020-2025 origin NERC SRA wind/solar expected/nameplate ratios, held fixed for each forecast and its target; conventional/hydro use summer physical MW; storage excluded explicitly, not treated as missing or zero actual capability
seasonal_index_claim: wind/solar-adjusted, storage-excluded BA inventory index; not ELCC, UCAP, risk-hour capacity or a validated native NERC balance
native_balance: do not fit or adopt an EIA-to-NERC balance conversion without matching footprint, resource tier, transfers, accreditation and response
training_weights: inverse repeat count for identical unit/horizon/target observations, times origin capacity; no future capacity as a fit weight
acceptance: stock evidence requires lower error than persistence and announced schedule, deletion robustness and region-block interval excluding zero; not sufficient for full-balance or long-horizon adoption
preservation: new directory only; keep all earlier models, data, paper/SI and figures unchanged; no push
